name: Stellar Storm
body:
School evocation; Level druid/shaman 6, magus 6, occultist 6, sorcerer/wizard 6, witch 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area cylinder (40-ft. Radius, 40 ft. high)
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Fiery plasma rains down from the stars into the area dealing 1d6 damage per level to all creatures and objects in the area (max 20d6).

The damage dealt is half fire damage and half electricity damage. A successful Reflex save halves this damage.

This spell is considered exposure to sunlight for creatures that fail their save and are affected by such effects.
